works.title: Cyril and Methodius of Thessalonica
works.subtitle: The Acculturation of the Slavs
works.author: Anthony-Emil N. Tachiaos
works.blurb: The brothers from Thessalonica who gave the Slavs an alphabet and the Liturgy in their own tongue — the definitive Orthodox study of the Apostles to the Slavs and their lasting work.
